# Karen Wilson

Karen Wilson is the current Deputy of [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Karen Wilson has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/karen-wilson#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 8 with 39.4% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/karen-wilson/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0oieAehO2rU)

Karen Wilson has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/08/former-health-minister-to-stand-in-st-clement/)\]
